title: C-O7b fix round 1: failed and unknown statuses in the handover snapshot, atomic plan.md write, throttle state out of pool_state, last heading match, single task read, non-merged worktrees only (from review T-0177)
spec:
Fix round for T-0119 (branch task/T-0119 at 41cf86a). Work in this task's worktree, cut from task/T-0119. Review T-0177 (opus) requested changes; items come from it. Scope: orchestrator/handover.py, orchestrator/daemon.py, tests/test_handover.py.

1 HIGH handover.py _status_groups: add a "failed" group (id, title, reason, resume_hint keys) and bucket any status outside queued/running/held/done/failed into an "other (<status>)" line so no child can vanish; a goal whose only child failed must render that child, never "no child tasks". Test: goal with one failed child (reason rebase_conflict) → section lists it under failed with the reason.

2 MED handover.py write: build the full new text first, write it to a sibling temp file in the same directory and os.replace() it over plan.md, inside the bus lock; never write_text() over plan.md directly. Test: patch os.replace to raise → plan.md unchanged.

3 LOW daemon.py throttle: keep the last-handover timestamp in `.orchestrator/handover_state.json` (read-modify-write under an fcntl flock on that file, truncate+write like pool._save_planner_account), not in pool_state.json. Adjust the throttle test.

4 LOW handover.py: replace the existing section by matching the LAST `## Auto-handover ` heading at line start (finditer → last), so Planner prose that quotes the heading earlier in the file is never deleted. Test: a plan.md containing the heading text inside a fenced block above the real section keeps that block.

5 LOW handover.py: read all tasks once (bus.read() without filter) before the loop and group children by parent in memory; no per-goal bus.read.

6 LOW handover.py _worktree_names: list only worktrees whose task id (directory name) belongs to a task that is not merged (merged_into unset) and skip wt/_state. Test with a merged task's worktree and a _state dir present.

No new dependency. Commit on the task branch when green. Finish with: summary, files changed, failures-only test output.
acceptance: Failed children render with reason under a failed group and unknown statuses under other; a goal with only a failed child never says no child tasks (test)
plan.md is written via temp file + os.replace inside the bus lock; a failing replace leaves plan.md unchanged (test)
Throttle timestamp lives in .orchestrator/handover_state.json under a flock; pool_state.json untouched by handover (test adjusted)
The last Auto-handover heading is replaced; earlier quoted headings survive (test)
Tasks are read once per write; worktree list excludes merged tasks and _state (test)
uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests green; no new dependency; only the three scoped files change; committed on the task branch

result.summary:
Committed on `task/T-0179` (3657876).

**Summary**

Fixed all 6 review items from T-0177:
1. `_status_groups` now buckets `failed` (with `reason`/`resume_hint` keys) and any unrecognized status into `other (<status>)`, so a goal never falsely reports "no child tasks."
2. `write()` builds the full text, writes to a sibling temp file, then `os.replace()`s it over `plan.md`, still inside `bus.locked()`; a failing replace leaves `plan.md` untouched (cleans up the temp file on error).
3. Daemon's handover throttle timestamp now lives in `.orchestrator/handover_state.json`, read-modify-write under an `fcntl` flock (mirrors `pool._save_planner_account`), no longer touching `pool_state.json`.
4. `write()` matches the *last* `## Auto-handover ` heading via `finditer`, so quoted headings earlier in the file survive.
5. `_render_section` does one `bus.read()` and groups children by parent in memory instead of a `bus.read()` per goal.
6. `_worktree_names` excludes `wt/_state` and any worktree whose task is already merged.

**Files changed:** `orchestrator/handover.py`, `orchestrator/daemon.py`, `tests/test_handover.py` (only the scoped three).

**Test output:** all green — `uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` → 216 tests OK; `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` exit 0. No failures to report.

No new dependencies.
